The quotation is about requesting a Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) review of the early years childcare market. The specific mechanism is a market investigation/competition review of a childcare services market.

The primary economic content is about market structure and competition in the childcare industry — this is industrial organization (L), specifically antitrust/market investigation (L4) and industry studies in services (L8).

The secondary dimension is the childcare/early years education aspect, which falls under I2 (Education and Research Institutions).
